actions.name: Energize Weapon
actions.description: As part of a standard or full action used to make attacks with a melee weapon, charge the weapon with one of the weapon core's energy types. Until end of turn, half of the weapon's damage is replaced with the chosen energy type.

actions.name: Boomerang Strike
actions.description: As part of a standard action to make a ranged attack with a thrown melee weapon, infuse the weapon with telekinetic magic, granting the returning weapon fusion for 1 minute. Only applies to mech weapons, not improvised weapons.

description.value:
Energetic nodes connect to the mech's weapon mounts.

Selection: When installed, choose two energy types from: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic.

Energize Weapon (2 PP): Convert half of a weapon's damage to one of the chosen energy types for 1 turn.

Boomerang Strike (2 PP): Grant the returning fusion to a thrown melee weapon for 1 minute.
